mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in UNRATE above 0.2 percentage points signals labor market tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not decline significantly (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses the 0.2pp threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of FEDFUNDS below 1% and GDPC1 above 13,500 billions of chained 2017 dollars signals a robust expansionary monetary and demand environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such conditions do not show significant positive deviation from baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, simultaneous rises in INDPRO (supply) and HOUST (demand) indexes signal peak economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to decline significantly during periods meeting the late-cycle expansion criteria (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 228.723 (as of t-1mo) signals accelerating inflation expectations, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns do not show significant negative deviation from baseline during periods of CPIAUCSL growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS (employment) crosses above 1.4 million in monthly totals, it signals a robust labor market, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not rise significantly when PAYEMS crosses the 1.4 million threshold (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high demand (GDPC1 > 13,558) and elevated supply (INDPRO > 98.0398) indicate market saturation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns do not decline significantly during periods of high GDPC1 and INDPRO (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.16%), rising rates and falling UNRATE (<8.3%) signal contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not decline significantly when both FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls (t-test p > 0.05).
